stories.title: MetroLink extension to MidAmerica St. Louis Airport gets opening date
stories.summary: MetroLink service to MidAmerica St. Louis Airport begins Nov. 30.

stories.title: St. Louis man indicted for federal arson in fires at 2 massage parlors that killed a woman in Cahokia Heights
stories.summary: Quentin S. Hanks, 36, was indicted on charges of one count of arson resulting in death and one count of arson.

stories.title: Minor shoots self in leg near Black Hawk Middle School, less than a week after stabbing incident
stories.summary: Police say an investigation revealed that a juvenile had sustained a non-life-threatening gunshot wound to an extremity.

stories.title: Man who killed pastor in Maryville denied request to leave mental health center
stories.summary: A circuit judge denied the request from Terry J. Sedlaceck to leave the center on a supervised group trip.

stories.title: Indoor sports facility opens in Metro East
stories.summary: It includes a Shoot 360 basketball training center alongside indoor basketball and volleyball facilities.

stories.title: Mother of 13-year-old killed at track meet responds to self-defense claim
stories.summary: "This is not a case of whodunnit," said Joel Schwartz, the attorney for Jakai Lewis. "My son was innocent," said Jennifer Macone, the mother of LaJuan Swopes.

stories.title: St. Louis officials seek feedback on Gravois Avenue safety upgrades
stories.summary: Neighbors say crossing the 5.7-mile corridor feels like a gamble as state officials weigh bike lanes, new signals and cul-de-sacs.

stories.title: The St. Louis board president's race gets its first public fight in a data center hearing, with two of its candidates in the room
stories.summary: Megan Green's data center fee cleared committee 5-0. Michael Browning voted present, then confirmed he's running for her job.

stories.title: Judge questions state’s bid to narrow St. Louis police takeover lawsuit, sets December conference
stories.summary: Missouri argued it can’t be sued over which police liabilities it assumed; the mayor called the motion “frivolous”

stories.title: St. Charles City Council to vote on land sale for $200 million indoor beach and condo project
stories.summary: The $4.15 million sale would clear the way for condos and a year-round lagoon beach next to the Family Arena. Visitors could buy day passes or memberships.

stories.title: Man shot at DoorDash drivers outside Cardinal Glennon hospital after argument over order, police say
stories.summary: Police said a man fired a shot at two DoorDash drivers after getting into an argument over his order outside SSM Health Cardinal Glennon Children's Hospital.

stories.title: Veterans Affairs deputy secretary reacts to NSA classified network going down temporarily
stories.summary: Adding to a string of nationwide tech outages, officials have not tied the failures together or to a cyberattack, while VA leader says their systems are 'safer.'
